# shoehorn_forge_mold (Resource)

Manages a Shoehorn Forge mold template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A mold that creates an empty GitHub repository.
resource "shoehorn_forge_mold" "github_repo" {
  slug        = "create-github-repo"
  name        = "Create GitHub repository"
  description = "An empty repository with branch protection"
  version     = "1.0.0"
  visibility  = "tenant"
  category    = "repository"
  tags        = ["github", "repository"]

  actions = [
    {
      action  = "github.repo.create"
      label   = "Create repository"
      primary = true
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (Attributes List) The actions available on the forge mold. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `category` (String) The category of the forge mold.
- `name` (String) The display name of the forge mold.
- `slug` (String) The immutable slug identifier of the forge mold.
- `version` (String) The version of the forge mold (e.g. 1.0.0). Changing forces replacement.
- `visibility` (String) The visibility of the forge mold. Valid values: public, tenant, private.

### Optional

- `defaults_json` (String) The default values as a JSON string.
- `description` (String) A description of the forge mold.
- `icon` (String) The icon identifier for the forge mold.
- `schema_json` (String) The mold input schema as a JSON string.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags for categorizing the forge mold.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the forge mold.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the forge mold is published.
- `updated_at` (String) The last update timestamp.
